title: EgoArgus: Benchmarking VLMs as Situational Assistants for Modality-Grounded User Supports
abstract: arXiv:2608.25561v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: VLMs are increasingly positioned as daily assistants that perceive first-person environments, follow user dialogue, and decide how to help. Existing egocentric benchmarks mainly evaluate visual understanding in isolation, leaving open whether models can arbitrate between visual evidence and user-provided language when the two are helpful, irrelevant, or conflicting. We introduce EgoArgus, a human-annotated dataset for evaluating egocentric assistants on understanding and decision tasks in five dialogue-video daily scenarios. Our results demonstrate that it is still challenging for current VLMs as reliable egocentric assistants, which requires identifying which modality is trustworthy and deciding when intervention is warranted. Deeper analysis also shows that existing modality bias mitigation methods are quite restricted to enhance performance, providing insights to aid practioners into the deployment of current VLMs as daily assistants.

translated_title: EgoArgus：将视觉语言模型作为基于模态的用户支持情境助手的基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25561v1 公告类型：新 摘要：视觉语言模型（VLMs）正日益被定位为日常助手，它们能够感知第一人称环境、遵循用户对话并决定如何提供帮助。现有的以自我为中心（egocentric）的基准测试主要孤立地评估视觉理解能力，而未解决当视觉证据与用户提供的语言在有用、无关或冲突时，模型是否能够进行仲裁的问题。我们引入了EgoArgus，这是一个人工标注的数据集，用于在五种对话-视频日常场景中评估以自我为中心的助手在理解和决策任务上的表现。我们的结果表明，当前视觉语言模型作为可靠的以自我为中心的助手仍然具有挑战性，这要求模型识别哪种模态值得信赖，并决定何时进行干预是合适的。更深入的分析还表明，现有的模态偏差缓解方法在提升性能方面相当有限，这为从业者部署当前视觉语言模型作为日常助手提供了见解。
tldr: 本文提出EgoArgus数据集，评估视觉语言模型在对话-视频日常场景中作为以自我为中心的助手时，能否在视觉证据与用户语言之间进行仲裁，并发现现有模型在此任务上仍具挑战且模态偏差缓解方法效果有限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EgoArgus, a benchmark evaluating whether VLMs can arbitrate between visual evidence and user language as egocentric assistants in daily dialogue-video scenarios, revealing current challenges and limited effectiveness of modality bias mitigation methods.
